verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document post-incident follow-up action items being tracked to completion or synced to an issue tracker. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: automated creation of Jira tickets during incident workflows (docs-2) and a runbook "Add Task List" step for in-incident tasks (docs-41). Neither shows that follow-ups are tracked to completion or kept in sync with the tracker.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, follow-up actions from incidents are tracked to completion and sync to our issue tracker
